names.summary: A 97-byte beacon containing a fast-running u4 counter, a GNSS position and velocity block (ECEF/ECI, about 1e5 raw per km, so units of 10 m), and a smooth narrow-band battery-like value at offset 59. Many GNSS fields hold -1 (no fix) in most frames, which is why the position fields show spurious sun correlations.

fields.name: uptime_counter
fields.rationale: Monotonic u4 counter with no resets in 16 days, rising about 194 per second; it is unaffected by sunlight. It could be a millisecond-scale or sub-tick uptime or timestamp, so the unit is uncertain. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF X from the TLE in 100% of fixed frames at about 1e5 raw per km (units of 10 m). The value -1 means no fix. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_y
fields.rationale: Matches ECEF Y from the TLE in all fixed frames at about 1e5 raw per km. The value -1 means no fix. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_eci_z
fields.rationale: Matches the Z coordinate at 99.4% of frames at about 1e5 raw per km. Z is the same in ECI and ECEF, so the frame label is ambiguous. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Signed 3-byte value matching ECEF X velocity in all fixed frames at about 1e5 raw per km/s (10 m/s units). It moves with the Y position, as expected for orbital motion. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_y
fields.rationale: The match is 96.8% but the scale of 2.56e7 per km/s is implausible compared with the neighbouring velocity fields. The field is probably misaligned: it may be a different width or offset, or part of a neighbouring field. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_eci_z
fields.rationale: Signed 3-byte value matching the Z velocity in all fixed frames at about 1e5 raw per km/s. Z velocity is the same in ECI and ECEF. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage
fields.rationale: Narrow band (spread 2%) in 8105-8324, consistent with a two-cell Li-ion pack in mV. It is higher in sun (rho 0.86), with a negative trend in shadow (-0.64) and a charged_by_sunlight hint. [3/3 samples agree]

names.health: No reboots were seen: the counter shows 0 resets in 16 days. The battery-like voltage is stable with no measurable drift, and it dips in shadow and recovers in sun as expected. There is no thermal data, so the evidence is limited.

names.summary: A 214-byte housekeeping/telemetry beacon containing counters, a GNSS fix (ECEF position and velocity, with no-fix values of -1 in most frames), an attitude quaternion, solar-array currents or powers, and a group of temperatures. Temperature-like signed bytes show thermal inertia of about 20 min. The orbit is LEO at 481 km, and every frame has an eclipse in the previous 80 min.

fields.name: uptime_or_obc_time_counter
fields.rationale: Monotonic u4 with no resets, at 0.003 counts/s (apparently sampled slowly); flat vs sun. Probably an uptime or a similar count, though the rate is odd. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: packet_sequence_counter
fields.rationale: u2 counter that rolls over (18 wraps), with a median step of 226 within a pass. It is sun-independent, so it is a sequence or frame counter that wraps by design. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Linear in ECEF X with 99910 raw per km (about 1e5, centimetres); all matched frames agree. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_ecef_y
fields.rationale: Linear in ECEF Y at about 1e5 raw/km, so centimetres, consistent with the X field. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_pos_eci_z
fields.rationale: Matches the Z coordinate at about 1e5 raw/km. ECI vs ECEF Z is identical, so the frame is ambiguous; likely the ECEF Z of the same block. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_x
fields.rationale: Linear in ECEF X velocity at about 1e5 raw per km/s (3-byte signed, mm/s... 1e5 raw per km/s = 0.01 m/s units). Moves with ECEF Y position. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_ecef_y
fields.rationale: Matches Y velocity in 98% of frames, but the scale of 2.56e7 is odd, versus 1e5 for the neighbouring fields. This is probably a misaligned field and the alignment is uncertain. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: gnss_vel_z
fields.rationale: s3 value matching z velocity (ECI in the evidence) at about 1e5 raw per km/s, so cm/s. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage
fields.rationale: Narrow band at 8105-8315, consistent with a two-cell pack in mV. It is smooth, higher in sun (rho 0.86) and falls in shadow, and the power hint says battery. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_current_a
fields.rationale: Near 1 in shadow and about 12 in sun, so a solar input. It moves with the other array channels. The scale is unknown. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_or_load_byte
fields.rationale: Rough 0-255 byte, higher in sun (rho 0.54) but noisy, so the class is unclear. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_1
fields.rationale: Shadow ~320 vs sun ~4500, so it is sun driven. The solar hint is consistent. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_1_current
fields.rationale: Plateau of ~1900 in sun, ~300 in shadow, rho 0.92; moves with the other panel channels. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_2_current
fields.rationale: Near 1 in shadow and ~290 in sun (rho 0.945), rough, a typical array input. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_3_current
fields.rationale: Constant 5 in shadow and ~330 in sun, rho 0.95; part of the panel group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_4_current
fields.rationale: Constant 8 in shadow, rising in sun, rho 0.93; grouped with the other panels. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: attitude_quaternion
fields.rationale: Four float32 values with unit norm in 100% of frames, so a quaternion. The first component is near 1, so the attitude is nearly constant. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_current_or_charge_counter
fields.rationale: Lagged sun correlation with tau of 20 min, higher in sun, over a range of 4-764. The hint says battery, but the evidence is weak. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_a
fields.rationale: Narrow band (54-71) that is warmer in shadow, moving with offset 153. The occasional 255 is probably a sentinel; this looks like an internal or heated component. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_b
fields.rationale: Behaves like offset 141: narrow, warmer in shadow, with 255 outliers. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: uptime_or_tick_counter
fields.rationale: u4 counter of about 3e7 that increases at 0.0167 per second, so it is probably a slow tick (about one per minute) or a time count. It has no resets. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: panel_temp_1
fields.rationale: Signed byte -17..23, tau 20 min, rho_lag 0.98. Trends up in sun and down in shadow, and moves with 163, 164 and 166. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: panel_temp_2
fields.rationale: Signed byte, swings -13..33, correlated with the group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: panel_temp_3
fields.rationale: Signed byte, tau 20 min, rho 0.98. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_panel_4
fields.rationale: Signed byte with the same sun/shadow trend signs, but an orbit-phase fit rather than a lag fit, and it is lower in sun. It may be a temperature with an offset. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: panel_temp_4
fields.rationale: Signed byte, tau 20 min, rho 0.985. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_1
fields.rationale: Small positive byte, warmer in shadow, falling in sun (trend 0.84, higher after sunset) with a long time constant. It is one of a group with 168-174, so it is likely a heated or internal temperature. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_2
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as 167 and moves with it as a group. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_3
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour: warmer in shadow, orbit-phase repeating. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_4
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour, with a 1-21 range. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_5
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour, with a slightly weaker lag correlation. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_6
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour, repeating with orbital phase. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_7
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour, with the largest shadow/sun ratio. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: temp_internal_8
fields.rationale: Same group behaviour as 173. [3/3 samples agree]

names.health: No reboots are visible: the u4 counters have no resets, and the u2 counter that wraps does so by design. Battery voltage (about 8.1-8.3 V) looks charged by sunlight, though its daily low drifts down by about 15 per 30 days; over 16 days this could be seasonal, so I am not sure it is ageing. Temperatures swing normally with the eclipse cycle, so I see no thermal anomaly.
